title: Symrise launches Mindera® Euca bringing plant-based product protection to rinse-off formulations
summary: ‒ Gives formulators 100% plant-based, enhanced product protection with a rich sensorial signature ‒ Helps brands answer clean beauty and wellness trends in rinse-off personal care, delivering strong performance and safety ‒ Builds on Symrise’s patented Mindera® platform, which now supports product protection across all personal care categories ‒ This new cosmetic ingredient joins the portfolio of Symrise's holistic Care & Wellness Division

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 씻어내는 제형에 식물성 제품 보호 기능을 제공하는 새로운 화장품 원료를 출시했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Symrise launches Mindera® Euca bringing plant-based product protection to rinse-off formulations
